title: Pharmeazor minimal medicine knowledge-graph ontology
purpose: Traceable medicine, product and source-evidence relations for the 40-medicine project corpus.
scope_note: This ontology represents source-supported information. It must not be used to prescribe, diagnose, or infer patient-specific doses.

Medicine.description: One of the 40 project medicines, identified by its stable M001-M040 ID.

Brand.description: Commercial/product name recorded in a source.

PharmaceuticalForm.description: Dosage form, for example comprimé pelliculé, gélule or solution injectable.

Strength.description: Product strength or concentration exactly as documented, for example 400 mg or 125 mg/5 mL. This is not a patient dose.

Registration.description: Registration number from a structured product source, when available.

SourceDocument.description: A collected RCP, leaflet, prescribing-information document or other named source document.

Passage.description: A processed, page-traceable passage from a SourceDocument.

Indication.description: A source-supported therapeutic indication phrase. It remains source-specific until manually normalized.

Contraindication.description: A source-supported contraindication phrase. It remains source-specific until manually normalized.

AdverseEffect.description: A source-supported adverse-effect phrase. It remains source-specific until manually normalized.

InteractionTerm.description: A medicine, substance, class or interaction concept named in an interaction source passage.

has_dci.description: Links a project medicine to its standardized active substance.

has_brand.description: Links a medicine to a commercial/product name recorded in a source.

has_form.description: Links a medicine to a documented pharmaceutical form.

has_strength.description: Links a medicine to product strength/concentration, never to an inferred patient dose.

has_registration.description: Links a medicine to a registration number from the nomenclature.

has_source_document.description: Links a medicine to a collected document about it.

contains_passage.description: Links a source document to one of its processed passages.

interacts_with.description: A candidate source-supported interaction relation; the object can be a medicine, substance or class phrase.

edge_evidence_rules.ambiguous_fact_handling: Write the candidate to review_queue.jsonl instead of edges.jsonl.
forbidden_inference: Do not infer a patient dose from a strength.
Do not convert a condition mentioned in a warning into a contraindication without clear source wording.
Do not merge similar clinical phrases unless a manual reviewer records the normalization decision.
